release_notes: Mandatory OPS 4.5.20 reliability release. Every active outlet member can see the outlet's daily tasks even when off duty; roster data is advisory and no longer hides Tasks or returns a fabricated empty page. Assignment still controls who can start, change, photograph or complete a Task. A captured Task photo is shown immediately, remains visible while D1 confirmation catches up, and clearly reports saved, queued or rejected status. TaskPhoto validation reads D1 and the published Cloudflare package only and does not wait on Google Sheets. Historical Tasks, assignments and photos are not rewritten.
